_about: Apple Support style, measured from 3 Apple Support videos at 1920x1080. Ryo's choices win where they conflict: Myriad Pro (Apple uses voice-over), gentle zoom factors; horizontal title cards on the left, vertical captions under the phone.

layout._note: h: the opening title is Apple's left title card at full title size (cap height ~6.3% of 1080 = 100px Myriad) on two lines, with the MacBook scaled to fit right of it so the whole desktop (and its new app shortcuts) stays in frame; in-app steps keep the MacBook centred with captions under it. v: hero title, then the phone centred in the frame (220 px above and below) with captions in the band under it.

move._note: one curve for every zoom, device move, text slide, push and wipe

caption._note: the first caption in an app enters once; later steps roll over to the next caption in place

transition._note: steps within an app change in place on the same device; the grey panel wipe is only for new-app cutscenes

zoom._note: the device stays steady: one gentle zoom per cut, on the last Dictionary step (AI notes), so it never has to zoom back out
